mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id AS userId, c.merchant_id AS merchantId, m.name AS merchantName, c.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, p.main_image AS productMainImage, c.sku_id AS skuId, s.sku_name AS skuName, s.spec_attributes AS specAttributes, s.price, s.original_price AS originalPrice, c.quantity, s.stock, CASE WHEN s.stock = -1 THEN TRUE WHEN s.stock >= c.quantity AND p.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.enabled = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS available, c.created_time AS createdTime, c.updated_time AS updatedTime FROM cart_items c INNER JOIN products p ON c.product_id = p.id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN product_skus s ON c.sku_id = s.id AND s.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN merchants m ON c.merchant_id = m.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.updated_time DESC
